messages:
jordan lee: Hey team - planning to be in Mexico City from 2024-09-01 to 2025-02-01 (about 5 months). Couple of specifics because I9m traveling with my newborn: 1) Is the WFH stipend prorated for a multi-month temporary homebase? 2) Will US medical / parental leave benefits continue if I'm physically in MX for that period? 3) Any payroll/tax nexus or social security concerns for Redwood for ~150 days in Mexico? 4) Can we ship company laptop + power adapter to MX and is VAT/customs an issue? 5) Is there any support for childcare/locally arranged daycare stipends?
maya (people-ops): Thanks Jordan. Submit a Temporary Homebase form and attach dates + temporary address. Stipend: prorated monthly; childcare is ad-hoc and requires pre-approval for expense reimbursement. Benefits: usually continue but some medical reimbursements depend on provider networks. Payroll/legal need to triage nexus for Mexico 150 days could trigger local obligations depending on activities.
sanjay (payroll): FYI: Mexico has employer social security rules that can apply even for shorter stays if work performed locally for Mexico-based entities or contractors. We'll run a nexus check once legal opens an advisory. Please don't switch bank or tax elections until payroll confirms.
nora (legal): Tagging legal. Important: tourist stays vs temporary resident status changes obligations. If you'll be on a tourist visa, that reduces some risks but doesn't eliminate PE risk. We'll open an advisory with our external counsel; please confirm you won't be contracting locally, invoicing MX clients, or hiring while there.
it-ops: We can ship laptop + MX power adapter via our vendor. Select "international ship" on the form. Vendor-managed import usually puts VAT on corporate PO; if vendor can't ship, submit pre-approval before personal import. Allow 10 business days for delivery.
benefits-team: Parental leave pay continues per policy if you're on Redwood payroll. Medical: telemedicine is global but in-person care in MX may not be covered directly; we can provide emergency coverage guidance and top-up options. For daycare assistance, submit an expense request with receipts and pre-approval will be needed.
maya (people-ops): Next steps: 1) please file the form with address + visa status 2) legal opens advisory (nora) 3) payroll runs nexus check (sanjay) 4) IT schedules vendor ship if you choose that option. HR-bot reminder below. If you need a provisional note for housing, DM me but it's at your risk until payroll/legal confirm.
hr-bot: AUTOMATED: Temporary homebase requests must be submitted >=15 business days before travel. Required attachments: temporary address, visa/work permit if applicable, travel dates. See: https://intranet.redwood/forms/temp-remote
jordan lee: Thanks all 14I filed the form and marked visa status as tourist with newborn documentation attached. I9m not doing any MX client work or hiring. Will wait for legal/payroll advisory before booking long-term housing.
